explanation: The characteristic roots are -5 and 1. A particular solution is cos(3x)/10+sin(3x)/5: substitution gives cosine coefficient -14/10+12/5=1 and sine coefficient -12/10-14/5=-4. Thus y=Ae^{-5x}+Be^x+cos(3x)/10+sin(3x)/5. The initial conditions give A+B=-1/2 and -5A+B=-1/2, so A=0 and B=-1/2. This proves option c.
